checks.detail: Reviewed frozen candidate 0e8bf8de7271... against the PRD via two candidate-bound native receipts and 13 screenshots from two runs. Runtime: all blocking checks pass in both receipts; identical states render pixel-identically across runs; the invalid-email submit produced the inline validation message. Interface: all PRD-8 surfaces present and on-direction — auth shell with Create one and Forgot password? links, Today due/focus/done summary, Inbox search plus three filters, Projects board with Planned/In progress/Done and archive, Calendar month+agenda, Focus empty state plus history, and Settings now including password, sessions, reminder deliveries, and delete account. Persistence: isolated store verified at app.focusboard.desktop/focusboard.sqlite3; 45/45 host-run tests cover restart persistence. Security: Argon2 hashing, hashed tokens, rate limits, anti-enumeration responses, user-scoped revocation with cross-user tests, server-side policy, deletion confirmation revoking all sessions. ISSUE-0016 verified: both signed-in Settings captures show PASSWORD and ACTIVE SESSIONS; all five new commands registered; delete-account section implemented but below the 800px fold (residual noted). Remaining gaps are evidence-lane debt, not observed product failure: external focusboard:// activation not_run (lane unavailable), external section-3 journey receipt missing (self-drive 16/16 untrusted), auth-recovery and PRD-9.2 captures absent, advisory white-box miscalibrated (non-gating). No user-blocking or degraded behavior found; pass with evidence issues open for host follow-up.

developer_outcome.summary: Performed the exact validation step: explicit opt-in warm and cold focusboard:// activations against the built binary each moved counters off zero into deeplink-counters.json; outbox writes validated in executed tests. Host replay recapture still decides the evidence issues and stays the Tester/Host handoff, not a blocker.

risk_note.summary: Highest validation risk is that the Host external-activation lane still cannot fire in this environment, leaving counters and outbox unused and the two evidence issues unresolved a seventh loop.
risk_note.validation: Developer self-validates counter increments and outbox writes via an explicit opt-in local activation and a mail-sink message; Host replay recapture in validation decides the issues, with an explicit environment-unavailable disposition as the bounded fallback.
risk_note.why_now: Both evidence issues are strategy_exhausted after six-plus treatment loops, and Settings depth is the last missing PRD-8 capability failing the phase gate; neither moves without this pairing.
